import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int gridN, t;
    static String[] a, b;
    static int[][] dist1 = new int[30][30];
    static int[][] dist2 = new int[30][30];
    static int[] dx = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[] dy = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static int whereX, whereY;
    static int source, sink;
    static int flowN;
    static ArrayList<Edge> e = new ArrayList<>();
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] g;
    static int[] di, ptr;
    
    static class Edge {
        int a, b, cap, flow;
        Edge(int a, int b, int cap, int flow) {
            this.a = a;
            this.b = b;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = flow;
        }
    }
    
    static boolean ok(int x, int y) {
        return x >= 0 && x < gridN && y >= 0 && y < gridN;
    }
    
    static void add(int a, int b, int cap) {
        Edge e1 = new Edge(a, b, cap, 0);
        Edge e2 = new Edge(b, a, 0, 0);
        g[a].add(e.size());
        e.add(e1);
        g[b].add(e.size());
        e.add(e2);
    }
    
    static void BFS1() {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{whereX, whereY});
        for (int i = 0; i <= 20; i++)
            Arrays.fill(dist1[i], Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2);
        dist1[whereX][whereY] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int x2 = x + dx[i], y2 = y + dy[i];
                if (ok(x2, y2) && dist1[x2][y2] >= Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2 && b[x2].charAt(y2) != 'Y') {
                    dist1[x2][y2] = dist1[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{x2, y2});
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    static boolean bfs() {
        Arrays.fill(di, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(source);
        di[source] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty() && di[sink] == -1) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (int id : g[v]) {
                int to = e.get(id).b;
                if (di[to] == -1 && e.get(id).flow < e.get(id).cap) {
                    q.add(to);
                    di[to] = di[v] + 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return di[sink] != -1;
    }
    
    static int dfs(int v, int flow) {
        if (flow == 0) return 0;
        if (v == sink) return flow;
        for (; ptr[v] < g[v].size(); ptr[v]++) {
            int id = g[v].get(ptr[v]);
            int to = e.get(id).b;
            if (di[to] != di[v] + 1) continue;
            int pushed = dfs(to, Math.min(flow, e.get(id).cap - e.get(id).flow));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e.get(id).flow += pushed;
                e.get(id ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
    
    static int max_flow() {
        int flow = 0;
        while (true) {
            if (!bfs()) break;
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            while (true) {
                int pushed = dfs(source, Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2);
                if (pushed == 0) break;
                flow += pushed;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }
    
    static void BFS2(int x, int y) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{x, y});
        for (int i = 0; i <= 20; i++)
            Arrays.fill(dist2[i], Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2);
        dist2[x][y] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int cx = cur[0], cy = cur[1];
            if (dist2[cx][cy] >= dist1[cx][cy]) continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int x2 = cx + dx[i], y2 = cy + dy[i];
                if (ok(x2, y2) && dist2[x2][y2] >= Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2 && a[x2].charAt(y2) != 'Y' && dist2[cx][cy] + 1 <= dist1[x2][y2]) {
                    dist2[x2][y2] = dist2[cx][cy] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{x2, y2});
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        gridN = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        a = new String[gridN];
        b = new String[gridN];
        for (int i = 0; i < gridN; i++) a[i] = sc.next();
        for (int i = 0; i < gridN; i++) {
            b[i] = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < gridN; j++) {
                if (b[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    // Replace with 'Y' in both grids
                    StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(b[i]);
                    sb.setCharAt(j, 'Y');
                    b[i] = sb.toString();
                    sb = new StringBuilder(a[i]);
                    sb.setCharAt(j, 'Y');
                    a[i] = sb.toString();
                    whereX = i;
                    whereY = j;
                }
            }
        }
        BFS1();
        int totalCells = gridN * gridN;
        source = 0;
        sink = 2 * totalCells + 1;
        flowN = 2 * totalCells + 5;
        g = new ArrayList[flowN];
        for (int i = 0; i < flowN; i++) g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        di = new int[flowN];
        ptr = new int[flowN];
        for (int i = 0; i < gridN; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < gridN; j++) {
                if (a[i].charAt(j) == 'Y') continue;
                int what = i * gridN + j + 1;
                int what2 = totalCells + i * gridN + j + 1;
                add(source, what, a[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                add(what2, sink, b[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                BFS2(i, j);
                for (int ptx = 0; ptx < gridN; ptx++) {
                    for (int pty = 0; pty < gridN; pty++) {
                        if (b[ptx].charAt(pty) == 'Y' || dist2[ptx][pty] > t) continue;
                        add(what, totalCells + ptx * gridN + pty + 1, a[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(max_flow());
    }
}
